  // cute small buttons
  div.flex.w-full.flex-wrap.g-3
    a.btn.btn-primary.btn-sm: "Primary button"
    a.btn.btn-secondary.btn-sm: "Secondary button"
    button.btn.btn-outline.btn-sm: "Outline button"
    a.btn.btn-danger.btn-sm: "Danger button"

  // default size
  div.flex.w-full.flex-wrap.g-3.mt-4
    a.btn.btn-primary: "Primary button"
    a.btn.btn-secondary: "Secondary button"
    button.btn.btn-outline: "Outline button"
    a.btn.btn-danger: "Danger button"

  // large buttons
  div.flex.w-full.flex-wrap.g-3.mt-4
    a.btn.btn-primary.btn-lg: "Primary button"
    a.btn.btn-secondary.btn-lg: "Secondary button"
    button.btn.btn-outline.btn-lg: "Outline button"
    a.btn.btn-danger.btn-lg: "Danger button"

  // extra large
  div.flex.w-full.flex-wrap.g-3.mt-4
    a.btn.btn-primary.btn-xl: "Primary button"
    a.btn.btn-secondary.btn-xl: "Secondary button"
    button.btn.btn-outline.btn-xl: "Outline button"
    a.btn.btn-danger.btn-xl: "Danger button"

Button groups

Group a series of buttons together on a single line with the .btn-group class.

  div.flex.w-full.flex-wrap.g-3
    a.btn.btn-primary: "Primary button"
    a.btn.btn-secondary: "Check out"
    a.btn.btn-danger: "Delete"
    button.btn.btn-primary: "Button element"

Preloaders

Spinners indicate loading states. Use the .spinner class or .btn-loading for buttons.

Dropdowns

Add .dropdown-toggle to any button inside a .dropdown container.

Basic dropdown
ProfileSettings
Log out
Edit
View
In button groups
With callbacks

onOpen, onClose, and onSelect events fire on the dropdown. By default, clicking a dropdown item closes the menu. Add data-dropdown-stay-open to keep it open, or have onSelect return false. Configure via Zaiku.init({ dropdown: { onOpen: fn, onClose: fn, onSelect: fn } }). Check the console.
